result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to build a dedicated handoff tracking tool tailored for small software development teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Investigation of cross-role handoff workflows, manual tracking friction, and tool consolidation needs for small software teams in Latvia.
- Excludes any payroll, accounting, invoicing, or financial advice functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Software Team Lead

Leads responsible for coordinating developer handoffs, sprint reviews, and weekly status synchronization.

- How many hours per week does your engineering team spend compiling and updating task handoffs between roles? (question-14879a20f09f53a4c1589710)
- What tools or manual documents do you currently use to communicate handoff status between engineers, QA, and product roles? (question-b2acf63cbe4cc4d96bc3aa32)

## Engineering Manager

Managers overseeing engineering operations, team productivity, and tooling adoption decisions.

- What criteria or budget constraints would govern deciding to purchase a specialized handoff tracking tool rather than adapting existing tools? (question-9e59a74badb51121bcb4612a)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software engineering teams in Latvia experience recurring friction when handing off tasks across team members.
- Teams have operational latitude to adopt third-party developer productivity tools if value is demonstrated.

## Evidence gaps

- Lack of verified empirical research or representative survey data from Latvian software development firms.
- Uncertainty around typical software tooling budgets and pricing expectations for development tooling in this target segment.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
